questions.question: The grill found a leak. `continueTurn` keeps the previous answer visible on ANY failure. So if your access to that data has been revoked, reopening a pin shows a refusal message with the old numbers still on screen underneath — decision 0028 says a revoked grant must produce a refusal, not a cached figure. How should a refused reopen behave?
options: Keep it visible for every failure

questions.question: Both Dashboard and Explore currently await the whole re-run BEFORE navigating to Ask, so you sit on the old page with no feedback and only then jump. That also makes 'the previous answer stays visible' and 'scroll to it' impossible — there's no Ask panel on screen yet. What should a click do?
